context_requirements: Active cell cycle progression with cells entering mitosis during the 6-24 h window
Expression of Aurora A and/or Aurora B kinase
Compromised p53/p21 postmitotic checkpoint for strong endoreduplication and apoptosis
Intact mitotic machinery for polyploidy and cytokinesis failure phenotypes
falsifiers: No change in mitotic or proliferation landmark genes at 24 h in any cell line
No induction of CDKN1A or p53 target genes in p53 wild-type lines
No reduction in G2/M or proliferation gene expression across all lines
No evidence of apoptosis or polyploidy-associated transcriptional changes at 24 h

evidence.supports: VX-680 induces endoreduplication and apoptosis preferentially in p53-compromised cells, with p21 induction in p53 wild-type cells
PHA-680632 inhibits Aurora kinases, reduces histone H3 Ser10 phosphorylation, and has antiproliferative activity across cancer cell lines
PF-03814735 inhibits Aurora1 and Aurora2, reduces phospho-Aurora and phosphohistone H3, and blocks cytokinesis causing polyploid multinucleated cells
ZM447439 interferes with mitotic spindle assembly and chromosome condensation without affecting basic cell cycle regulator oscillations
AZD2811 nanoparticle Aurora B inhibitor shows extended pharmacodynamic reduction of phosphorylated histone H3 in tumors
